title: Long March 2D / Unknown Payload (Taiyuan LC-9)

pad.src: https://ll.thespacedevs.com/2.3.0/launches/e0a11eb1-0bda-4872-b36b-140247fd5c60/ (Launch Complex 9, latitude 38.863128, longitude 111.589567). The same record's Taiyuan location centroid is 38.8491N 111.608E; there is no pad table in this repo, so the pad point is used, as on lm2d-jiuquan.

azimuth_deg.note: Mean of the great-circle bearings from the LL2 LC-9 pad to the two NOTAM Q-line centres. A5897/26 (A)ZLHW ZHWH, B)2611182243 C)2611182305, Q-line centre 3322N11036E = 33 deg 22 min N, 110 deg 36 min E (33.3667N 110.6000E), bearing 188.57 deg, 618 km. A5898/26 (A)ZHWH, B)2611182244 C)2611182310, Q-line centre 3015N11004E = 30 deg 15 min N, 110 deg 04 min E (30.2500N 110.0667E), bearing 188.73 deg, 968 km (https://space-notices.com/notice/notam-ZHWH-A5898%2F26). Mean 188.65 deg. Non-rotating inclination from this pad and azimuth is about 96.7 deg (SSO at 500 km is about 97.4 deg): a southbound sun-synchronous-type ascent. Boxes confirmed on the notices: A5897 N333400E1103100-N333200E1104400-N331000E1104100-N331100E1102700; A5898 N303500E1095700-N303300E1101900-N295400E1101300-N295700E1095000.

payload_kg.note: FITTED to reach the ASSUMED orbit at the typical vernier cutoff. Payload is unknown (LL2 'Unknown Payload'); the fitted value is NOT an estimate.

insertion_alt_km.assumption: Target orbit is NOT published (LL2 orbit Unknown). 500 km circular is an ASSUMED sun-synchronous-type insertion consistent with the southbound NOTAM azimuth. Not a mission source. LL2's Long March 2D configuration record has a generic vehicle apogee field of 500 km; that field is not this flight's orbit and is not used as a source.

header_notes: ILLUSTRATIVE. PRE-FLIGHT. Long March 2D, unknown payload, Taiyuan Launch Complex 9. LL2 id e0a11eb1-0bda-4872-b36b-140247fd5c60, status Go, NET 2026-11-18T22:50:00Z (Wed 18 Nov 2:50 p.m. PST), window 22:43-23:05Z, orbit Unknown (net precision on the record is Hour). NOTAM windows match the LL2 window.

Vehicle and stage data reused from the lm2d-jiuquan entry (vehicles/lm2d.json): configuration-2 masses and the SAST TYPICAL sequence via huijiwiki, S1 vacuum via the YF-20 ratio, verniers ASSUMED to run from S2 ignition to 705.1 s, 3.35 m fairing 860 kg ASSUMED, Cd transferred from the LM-3B fit. Event times are the typical sequence, not this flight's. No altitude/range knots are published.
TARGET ASSUMED: 500 km circular SSO-class. Azimuth 188.65 deg is the mean bearing from the pad through the A5897/26 and A5898/26 Q-line centres (188.57 and 188.73 deg). No deploy time is published.

deploy.note: No payload-deploy time is published (LL2 payload and orbit Unknown). The SAST typical sequence lists separation at 737.1 s, but that time is not this flight's, so it is not used.

cd.assumption: free-molecular Cd 2.2, same assumption as lm2d-jiuquan

area_m2.derived: pi x (3.35 m / 2)^2, LM-2D S2 diameter, same derivation as lm2d-jiuquan

notes: Typical-sequence residual-propellant venting after separation is not modelled.

fitted.method: scipy least_squares (TRF, bounded) vs published knots + target orbit

payload_kg.basis: upper bound LM-2D LEO capability 4 t (huijiwiki); payload unknown
